meta: Translate documents with AI and keep industry terms consistent: the translation reads smoothly, but each page translates the same word differently.

muc.title: Smooth translation, wrong terms
muc.text: AI translations read smoothly, but a common problem is each page translating the same term a different way.

muc.title: Give AI a glossary
muc.text: Give AI your company's glossary, one translation per term, and ask it to use them consistently.

muc.title: Check numbers and names
muc.text: After translating, check numbers, dates, currencies and names, because one wrong number can ruin a contract.

muc.title: Important documents
muc.text: For contracts or legal documents, AI's translation is only a draft. A qualified person must review it.

muc.title: Your ten terms
muc.text: Make a table of ten terms from your field, paste it with one page of a document, ask AI to translate, then check which words don't match the table.
